{{Top|leg}}
The '''Emperor suite''' was one of the two luxury suites on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']], the other being the [[Kuari suite]]. It featured deluxe refreshment centers, split-level entertainment room, [[holo-overlay projector]] with a [[sensory adapter]], a stock of vintage [[Pludris]] [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]], an original [[kinesculpture]] by [[Xephi Sep]], private [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[butler]], [[zero-g sauna]], and a private [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. Each suite cost one thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a [[Standard day/Legends|day]].
